verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents periodic access reviews tied to policy timelines, automated evidence gathering, and validation of access changes before completing a review, plus reuse of prior review data to speed up subsequent reviews — covering the core workforce access-review workflow. However, the evidence never explicitly describes an in-app reviewer sign-off step or confirms the review artifact is stored in a distinct 'evidence library' object. Missing for 10: explicit reviewer sign-off/attestation UI, explicit confirmation that the review record is filed into the evidence library artifact store.
